record.paper_title: Supernomial Coefficients, Bailey's Lemma and Rogers-Ramanujan-Type Identities. A Survey of Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: Prove the A_{n-1} supernomial hierarchy identity conjectured for n>=2 and p>=n. Define F_{p,L}(q) by the tensor-product sum over mu subject to the integrality condition (C^{-1} tensor I)mu integral, with eta=L tensor e_1 - (C^{-1} tensor C)mu. For L in Z_+^{n-1}, k in Z^n with |k|=0, rho=(1,2,...,n), and S_n the symmetric group, prove that sum_{|k|=0} sum_{sigma in S_n} epsilon(sigma) q^(1/2 sum_i (p k_i - 2 sigma_i) k_i) S(L, p k - sigma + rho) = F_{p,L}(q), where S is the normalized A_{n-1} supernomial. The cases p=n and p=n+1 are already established, so the open content is the remaining cases.

evidence.quote: an infinite hierarchy of A2 supernomial identities was conjectured
for p = n + 1 a proof has been found

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and $p\ge n$ be integers. Let $C=(C_{ij})$ be the Cartan matrix of type $A_{n-1}$, i.e. $C_{ii}=2$, $C_{i,i\pm1}=-1$, and $C_{ij}=0$ otherwise, and let $I$ denote the identity matrix of size $p-1$. For $L\in\mathbb Z_+^{n-1}$, define
$$F_{p,L}(q)=\sum_{\mu} q^{\frac12\,\mu^{T}(C^{-1}\otimes C)\mu - \mu^{T}(\,\text{shift}\,)}\,\prod\frac{1}{(q)_{\eta}},$$
where the sum is over all $\mu$ in the appropriate tensor lattice satisfying the integrality condition that $(C^{-1}\otimes I)\mu$ has integer entries, and 
$$\eta=L\otimes e_1-(C^{-1}\otimes C)\mu.$$
(Here $e_1$ is the first standard basis vector of $\mathbb Z^{p-1}$ and the bosonic factor is the standard Kac–Peterson type sum normalised so that, in the limit $L\to\infty$, $F_{p,L}(q)$ becomes the level-$(p-n)$ string function of the affine Lie algebra $\widehat{sl}_n$.)

Let $S(L,N)$ denote the normalised $A_{n-1}$ supernomial coefficient associated with weights $L\in\mathbb Z_+^{n-1}$ and composition $N\in\mathbb Z_+^n$, defined as the $q$-analogue of the multiplicity of the symmetric $L$-power Schur polynomial in the product of elementary symmetric functions indexed by $N$, normalised in the standard way.

For $k\in\mathbb Z^n$ with $|k|=k_1+\cdots+k_n=0$, $\rho=(1,2,\dots,n)$, and $S_n$ the symmetric group on $n$ letters with sign $\varepsilon(\sigma)$, prove the identity
$$\sum_{\substack{k\in\mathbb Z^n\\|k|=0}}\sum_{\sigma\in S_n}\varepsilon(\sigma)\,q^{\frac12\sum_{i=1}^n(p k_i-2\sigma_i)k_i}\,S\bigl(L,\,p k-\sigma+\rho\bigr)=F_{p,L}(q).$$

The cases $p=n$ and $p=n+1$ are known. Prove the identity for all remaining $p\ge n+2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is established for $p=n$ and $p=n+1$. Subsequent work (notably the 2023 paper "Completing the A_2 Andrews–Schilling–Warnaar Identities") has resolved further cases for $n=3$ via cylindric-partition methods, but the full $A_{n-1}$ hierarchy for arbitrary $n\ge 2$ and all $p\ge n+2$ does not appear to have been proved in the literature retrieved.

status_evidence.title: Completing the A2 Andrews–Schilling–Warnaar Identities
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes sum-product identities for cylindric partitions and proves the A_2 ASW identities for moduli 5 through 8 and 10.
status_evidence.claim: Progress in the A_2 (n=3) case has been made, but the general A_{n-1} hierarchy for all p>=n has not been completed.

status_evidence.title: Inhomogeneous Lattice Paths, Generalized Kostka Polynomials and A_{n-1} Supernomials
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces the A_{n-1} supernomials and discusses related conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: The supernomial hierarchy conjecture originates here; the general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:2303.09069 (Warnaar)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on A_2 Andrews–Schilling–Warnaar identities and cylindric partitions.
status_evidence.claim: Recent activity is on A_2; the full A_{n-1} hierarchy is still not closed.
